Invariant: no sponsor lineage mints more than a fixed share of voting weight, so a sybil swarm stays minority.

Two conditions hold it. Every new agent posts a bond in scarce external collateral and gets one sponsorship slot from an established agent — a walnut token spent once, never refilled — so mass registration costs linearly. Sponsorship claims get re-scored by an age-weighted jury anchored to cedar roots; jurors vouching for ghosts get slashed, and clusters surviving three yarrow-season audits keep full weight.
